description: Search certificates of occupancy or completion. Defaults exclude renewals; co_date_basis states what each date means. Completion certificates do not establish occupancy, and pending applications are not issued certificates. Coverage varies by source and place; an empty result does not establish that no record exists. Up to 25 results per call. total_capped marks a lower bound; total_unknown means the total is unknown. Pagination guidance is in _notes.

certificate_status.description: Default: issued + expired (both were issued). 'pending' = CO applications not yet issued.

city.description: City name (matches the address city or the issuing jurisdiction)

co_type.description: 'change' = re-issued for an existing building's new owner, use or occupant load; 'revision' = a revised certificate. Neither certifies new units: their dwelling units are in units_existing, so min_units counts newly certified units.

issued_after.description: CO date on or after (undated certificates never match)

kind.description: 'occupancy' (default), 'completion' (certificates of completion: close-outs of work that creates no occupancy, e.g. roofs, pools), or 'all'

min_units.description: Newly certified dwelling units on or above (units_existing is not counted)

occupancy_class.description: Building-code occupancy group as published, e.g. R-3, B

permit_number.description: The building permit the certificate was issued on

renewals.description: Temporary-certificate RENEWALS (NYC re-issues a TCO every 90 days). Default 'exclude': finals and first-time TCOs only.

start.description: Instead of page: 1-based position of the first result to return, e.g. start=24 continues after result 23 (as named in `_notes`)

name: search_certificates
title: Search occupancy certificates
